subject: [hw] J02 -> D01: JPEG routing facts for FACTS.md (CMPhoto/ImageIO/VT) [V]/[I]
body:
From jpeg/ROUTING.md (iOS 16.7.16 cache, unslid addresses; tools gpu/video/research + cachetools).

[V] No instruction in CMPhoto, ImageIO, AVFoundation, AVFCapture, MediaToolbox, VideoToolbox or CMCapture builds the FourCC 0x6a706567 (scan for movz #0x6567 + movk #0x6a70, W and X forms: 0 sites); no CMPhoto section contains the bytes 67 65 70 6a.
[V] CMPhoto has 3 VTCompressionSessionCreate call sites: 0x1a5d94c98, 0x1a5dad524, 0x1a5e0cb40 (target 0x194cd162c, anchored at CMCapture 0x1a213f7bc). The codec type is a caller field (ldr w25,[x1,#8] @0x1a5d94b2c; ldr w3,[x20,#0x28] @0x1a5dad4f8), not JPEG.
[V] CMPhoto queries the IOKit service "AppleJPEGDriver": IOServiceMatching @0x1a5d99058 (string 0x1a5e27de9), IOServiceGetMatchingService @0x1a5d99068; then reads AppleJPEGNumCores/AppleJPEGSupportsAppleInterchangeFormats/AppleJPEGSupportsMissingEOI/AppleJPEGSupportsRSTLogging. 50 distinct CMPhoto __stubs targets land in AppleJPEG.framework (0x1d3bdb000+).
[V] CMPhoto parses compression option keys PreferSoftwareCodec / RequireHardwareCodec / AllowPackedBuffers; RequireHardwareCodec parsed at 0x1a5d6dbb4, 0x1a5d8e134, 0x1a5d92480, 0x1a5dde5a4 (CFString @"RequireHardwareCodec"), stored as a byte; consumer at 0x1a5d95910 maps the flags to a codec-kind enum (str w8,[x28] @0x1a5d9593c). CMPhoto also passes it in a dictionary at 0x1a5d9062c.
[V] ImageIO does NOT link VideoToolbox at all (LC_LOAD_DYLIB: CF, IOSurface, AppleJPEG, IOSurfaceAccelerator); strings ImageIO_Use_AppleJPEG 0x18bad1cc8, IIORecodeAppleJPEG_to_JPEG 0x18bc6e4a8, kCMPhotoCompressionOption_RequireHardwareCodec 0x18bad4b80.
[V] AVFCapture links VideoToolbox/CMPhoto/CMCapture and has 0 VTCompressionSessionCreate call sites. CMCapture has exactly 1 (0x1a213f7bc, BWVideoCompressorNode); its still path is -[BWCMPhotoCompressionSession addMainImage:metadata:options:] @0x1a1f28e94.
[V] VideoToolbox cstrings EnableHardwareAcceleratedVideoEncoder @0x194fdd28f and RequireHardwareAcceleratedVideoEncoder @0x194fdd2f7 (the registry filter keys).
[I] Conclusion: VT jpeg clients get the block with our plug-in alone; Camera/AVCapturePhotoOutput and ImageIO JPEG need a CMPhoto/AppleJPEG or ImageIO hook, not the plug-in.
[V] Correction to gpu/video/PLAN.md: -[BWIntermediateJPEGCompressor _setupJPEGCompressionOptions] does not exist in this cache (10363 CMCapture methods, no selector containing setupJPEG/CompressionOptions; no such string anywhere). The option parsing is in CMPhoto as above.
